## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 40 captures during August 2023. This activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the reporting period. The capture total should continue to be monitored alongside the handling of image-quality issues and the time taken to complete grading.

## Image quality

Of the captures submitted, 1 was assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.5%. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support process. Maintaining clear records of these issues will assist with identifying any continuing effect on image quality.

## Grading

There were 12 referable results during August 2023. The median grading lag was 1 day. This indicates that grading was generally completed promptly during the period, while referable results should continue to be managed through the established clinical review and follow-up arrangements. Further monitoring will support oversight of both grading timeliness and the quality of submitted captures.
